Posting date: November 2026
Job title: Data Analyst (mid-level)
Team: Business Intelligence, regional retail company

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain recurring sales and inventory reports.
- Write SQL queries against the company data warehouse.
- Maintain dashboards used by store and regional managers.
- Answer ad hoc questions from business stakeholders.

Required qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or similar).
- At least 3 years of professional experience writing SQL for reporting or analysis.
- Hands-on experience building dashboards in Tableau or Power BI.

Preferred qualifications:
- Python or R for data analysis.
- Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests.

Posting date: November 2026
Job title: Staff Accountant
Team: Corporate Accounting, mid-sized manufacturing company

Responsibilities:
- Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations.
- Support the monthly and quarterly close.
- Maintain fixed asset and prepaid schedules.
- Assist with year-end audit requests.

Required qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
- At least 2 years of experience with general ledger work and month-end close.
- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation workbooks).

Preferred qualifications:
- CPA license or progress toward the CPA exam.
- Experience with an ERP system such as NetSuite or SAP.

Posting date: November 2026
Job title: Logistics Coordinator
Team: Distribution Operations, consumer goods distributor

Responsibilities:
- Schedule inbound and outbound shipments with carriers.
- Track deliveries and resolve delays and exceptions.
- Keep shipment records accurate in the warehouse and transportation systems.
- Coordinate daily priorities with the warehouse team.

Required qualifications:
- At least 3 years of experience in logistics, transportation, or supply chain coordination.
- Hands-on experience with a warehouse management system (WMS) or transportation management system (TMS).
- Associate's degree or higher, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience negotiating rates or service terms with carriers.
- Lean or Six Sigma training.

Posting date: November 2026
Job title: Customer Support Team Lead
Team: Customer Support, subscription software company

Responsibilities:
- Lead a team of 8 to 10 support agents handling phone, chat, and email.
- Coach agents and run weekly one-on-ones.
- Monitor queue health and service-level targets.
- Handle escalated customer cases.

Required qualifications:
- At least 4 years of customer support experience.
- At least 1 year of experience formally leading or supervising a support team.
- Experience with a ticketing or CRM platform such as Zendesk or Salesforce Service Cloud.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience building or running a quality assurance (QA) program.
- Workforce management or scheduling experience.

Posting date: November 2026
Job title: Backend Software Developer
Team: Platform Engineering, online payments company

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain backend services and REST APIs.
- Write automated tests and take part in code reviews.
- Work with relational databases and write efficient SQL.
- Join the on-call rotation for production services.

Required qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- At least 2 years of professional backend development in Java or Python.
- Experience designing REST APIs and working with SQL databases.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with a public cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Experience setting up or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
